queue.classification: seven scoped dossiers; five eligible and two held

dossiers.signature: export function isEnvironmentMode(value: string): value is EnvironmentMode
dossiers.shape: String membership classifier over four canonical literals; invokes Set.has
dossiers.dependencyBoundary: private Set ENVIRONMENT_MODE_SET and its Set.has call; no exported mutator observed

dossiers.shape: default membership classifier over six uncertain states; exported runtime-mutable state remains reachable
dossiers.dependencyBoundary: exported ReadonlySet object OMNI_UNCERTAIN_STATES and its Set.has call; mutation preservation is unresolved

dossiers.shape: pure String classifier over four terminal scope literals
dossiers.dependencyBoundary: literal comparisons only; no helper calls or mutable state observed; no I/O or scheduling effect

dossiers.signature: function isTaskEffect(value: string): value is TaskDefinition["effects"][number]
dossiers.shape: String membership classifier over eight effects; allocates an array and invokes Array.includes
dossiers.dependencyBoundary: source array membership and Array.includes host call; existing twin uses two bounded helper flows to fit its physical profile

dossiers.shape: pure String classifier accepting only public
dossiers.dependencyBoundary: literal comparison only; no helper calls or mutable state observed; no I/O or scheduling effect

commonControls.inputDomain: The TypeScript signatures are String-typed; wrong-class refusal is a proposed physical boundary and is not attributed to current TypeScript runtime behavior
commonControls.effects: Per-symbol dependencies above govern effects. Four symbols are observed pure under default module state; isOmniUncertain depends on reachable exported mutable state and is not semantically closed.
commonControls.hostAssumptions: Set.has and Array.includes retain ordinary built-in behavior; prototype replacement and state-mutation controls are required before admission

decision: The five dossiers are ready for a bounded reversible review wave. They do not authorize new or bulk Fungi source until the owner converts the proposal to an exact-head authorizing admission.
